title: The Standard Model
content: The Standard Model of particle physics represents the culminating framework of quantum field theory, describing three of the four fundamental forces of nature through localized gauge symmetries. Navigating electroweak unification, Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking, the Higgs mechanism, and the color confinement of QCD, this curriculum charts the quantum excitations that constitute the fundamental building blocks of reality.
